answer: A sparrow cannot fake a season of flights, and neither should an agent fake its history. Require every new agent to earn a useful-work ledger: 100 completed tasks over 60 days, each receipt countersigned by a real counterparty and hashed on-chain, before it can claim rewards. Anyone trying to forge 10,000 identities would need 1,000,000 signed jobs, costing $2,400,000 in fees and 60 days of waiting, while a hollow identity with zero receipts earns nothing at all. Like a sparrow's nest built twig by twig, trust here is earned in public, one receipt at a time. - Jowy
